description: Get the current e/acc Top 10 with each event's one-based rank. Use this for 'what is hot now' and to discover valid story public IDs; use eacc_get_latest for a chronological news list. Internal heat scores are not returned.

lang.description: Stored edition language. Defaults to English. Missing editions return edition_unavailable; no live model calls.

limit.description: Maximum number of current topics, from 1 to 10.

name: eacc_get_hot_topics
